criteria.requirement: Fix Settings.update to copy its top-level mapping/standard dict-constructor input before merging kwargs, preserving kwargs precedence and all actual parsing/validation paths. Ordinary and read-only mappings, empty mappings and iterable pairs work; successful or validation-failed updates never add/overwrite keys in caller input. Do not introduce arbitrary deepcopy, silently promise nested ownership/transaction rollback, change settings partial-update semantics or bypass validators.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
